Build an image in ACR without a local Docker daemon: {{c1::az acr build -r <registry> -t myimage:{{c2::v1}} .}}
column2: ACR Tasks builds in the cloud from the local context.

column1: Deploy manifests to a cluster: {{c1::kubectl apply -f}} deployment.yaml
column2: apply is declarative and idempotent.

column1: See why a crashed Pod died: kubectl logs <pod> {{c1::--previous}}
column2: Reads the previous container instance's logs.

column1: Newest cluster warnings first: kubectl get events {{c1::--sort-by=.lastTimestamp}}
Watch a rolling update: kubectl {{c1::rollout status}} deployment/myapp
column2: Undo with: kubectl rollout undo deployment/myapp.

column1: KEDA ScaledObject that costs nothing when idle: minReplicaCount: {{c1::0}}
column2: Pair with a queue-length scaler and a sane maxReplicaCount.

column1: Split traffic in Container Apps: az containerapp ingress traffic set --revision-weight {{c1::latest=80 previous=20}}
column2: Requires multiple revision mode.

column1: App Service container on a custom port: set {{c1::WEBSITES_PORT}} to the container's listen port.
Cosmos DB vector query: SELECT c.content FROM c ORDER BY RANK {{c1::VectorDistance}}(c.embedding, @qv)
column2: Needs a vector embedding policy + vector index (diskANN for scale).

column1: Cosmos DB Python entry point: CosmosClient(url, credential={{c1::key}}).get_database_client(db).{{c2::get_container_client}}(container)
Cheapest Cosmos DB read: a {{c1::point read}} using id + partition key (~1 RU per 1 KB)
Enable pgvector: CREATE EXTENSION {{c1::vector}};
column2: On Flexible Server first set the azure.extensions server parameter.

column1: Cosine similarity search in pgvector: ORDER BY embedding {{c1::<=>}} $1 LIMIT 5
column2: <-> = L2, <#> = inner product.

column1: HNSW index on embeddings: CREATE INDEX ON docs USING {{c1::hnsw}} (embedding {{c2::vector_cosine_ops}});
column2: Ops class must match the distance operator.

column1: Tune IVFFlat at query time: SET ivfflat.{{c1::probes}} = 10;
column2: Build-time knob is "lists"; build the index after data load.

column1: RAG with metadata filter: SELECT content FROM docs WHERE {{c1::tenant_id = $2}} ORDER BY embedding <=> $1 LIMIT 5;
column2: Filter in SQL, not in app code.

column1: Cache-aside write with TTL: SET user:42 "{{c1::value}}" {{c2::EX 300}}
column2: Delete the key on DB writes to invalidate.

column1: Redis set-if-absent lock: SET lock:job token {{c1::NX}} EX 30
RediSearch vector index: FT.CREATE idx ON HASH SCHEMA embedding VECTOR {{c1::HNSW}} 6 TYPE FLOAT32 DIM {{c2::1536}} DISTANCE_METRIC COSINE
RediSearch KNN query: FT.SEARCH idx "{{c1::*=>[KNN 5 @embedding $vec]}}" PARAMS 2 vec <blob> DIALECT {{c2::2}}
Send to Service Bus in Python: client.get_queue_sender(q).send_messages({{c1::ServiceBusMessage}}("body"))
Settle a processed message (PeekLock): receiver.{{c1::complete_message}}(msg)
column2: Alternatives: abandon_message, dead_letter_message, defer_message.

column1: A message moves to the DLQ after {{c1::MaxDeliveryCount}} failed deliveries (default 10)
column2: Also: expired TTL, filter errors, explicit dead-letter.

column1: Python v2 HTTP function: @app.route(route="hello", auth_level=func.AuthLevel.{{c1::ANONYMOUS}})
Timer trigger every 5 minutes (NCRONTAB, seconds first): {{c1::0 */5 * * * *}}
column2: 6 fields; UTC by default.

column1: Event Grid dead-letters failed events to a {{c1::storage blob container}}
column2: Retry default: ~30 attempts over 24h, exponential backoff.

column1: Function app deploy: func azure functionapp publish {{c1::<app-name>}}
Retrieve a Key Vault secret: SecretClient(vault_url, credential).{{c1::get_secret}}("db-password").{{c2::value}}
Key Vault reference in an app setting: {{c1::@Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=https://vault/secrets/name)}}
App Config live refresh works by changing the {{c1::sentinel}} key
column2: Provider reloads config only when the sentinel changes.

column1: Open a traced operation: with tracer.{{c1::start_as_current_span}}("process-message"):
Point OTel at a local collector: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT={{c1::http://localhost:4318}}
column2: Jaeger UI on :16686.

column1: Trace context travels between services in the {{c1::traceparent}} header (W3C Trace Context)
KQL, last hour: traces | where timestamp {{c1::> ago(1h)}}
KQL, count per 5-minute bucket: requests | summarize {{c1::count()}} by {{c2::bin(timestamp, 5m)}}
KQL, top talkers: ... | summarize count() by user_Id | {{c1::top 10 by count_ desc}}
KQL, p95 latency per dependency: dependencies | summarize {{c1::percentile(duration, 95)}} by target | order by ... desc
KQL, whole-term match (fast): where message {{c1::has}} "timeout"
column2: contains = substring (slower).

column1: KQL, chart it: ... | render {{c1::timechart}}
Start the local Azure emulator and load env: floci az start && eval $(floci {{c1::az env}})
column2: Services on :4577; Service Bus AMQP on :5673.

column1: Create a local k8s cluster for manifest practice: {{c1::kind create cluster}} --name ai200
column2: Teardown: kind delete cluster --name ai200.

column1: List floci-az SDK endpoints: eval $(floci az env {{c1::--format sdk-vars}})
column2: Exports AZURE_KEY_VAULT_ENDPOINT, AZURE_APP_CONFIGURATION_ENDPOINT, ...

column1: Get AKS credentials for kubectl: az aks {{c1::get-credentials}} -g <rg> -n <cluster>
column2: Merges into ~/.kube/config.

column1: Stop scheduling on a node, then evict its Pods: kubectl {{c1::cordon}} <node>; kubectl {{c2::drain}} <node> --ignore-daemonsets
Cosmos DB change feed (pull model) in Python: container.{{c1::query_items_change_feed}}()
Half-precision pgvector column: embedding {{c1::halfvec}}(1536)
column2: Halves memory/index size.

column1: HNSW recall at query time: SET hnsw.{{c1::ef_search}} = 100;
column2: Higher = more recall, more compute.

column1: Invalidate a cached key on write: {{c1::DEL}} user:42
Batch Redis calls in redis-py: pipe = r.{{c1::pipeline}}()
column2: One round trip for many commands.

column1: Send a poison message to the Service Bus DLQ: receiver.{{c1::dead_letter_message}}(msg, reason="poison")
Service Bus filter that exact-matches application properties efficiently: {{c1::correlation}} filter
column2: SQL filters are the flexible alternative.

column1: Declarative queue write in a v2 Function: @app.{{c1::queue_output}}(queue_name="out", connection="...")
Local-only Function settings file: {{c1::local.settings.json}}
column2: Never commit it; in Azure these become app settings / Key Vault references.

column1: Event Grid retry knobs: {{c1::maxDeliveryAttempts}} and {{c2::eventTimeToLive}}
column2: Defaults ≈ 30 attempts / 24h.

column1: Create a new secret version in Key Vault: client.{{c1::set_secret}}("name", "new-value")
Feature flag keys in App Configuration live under the prefix {{c1::.appconfig.featureflag/}}
The OTel component that exports finished spans: {{c1::SpanProcessor}} + exporter (e.g. OTLP HTTP)
KQL unnest a dynamic array: {{c1::mv-expand}}
KQL reusable variable: {{c1::let}} cutoff = ago(1d);
Redis TTL key returns {{c1::-1}} = key exists with no expiry; {{c2::-2}} = key does not exist
Service Bus receive modes: {{c1::ReceiveAndDelete}} = at-most-once; {{c2::PeekLock}} = at-least-once
column2: PeekLock completes only after successful processing.

column1: ACR geo-replication requires the {{c1::Premium}} tier
column2: Also gates private endpoints and content trust.

column1: A function has exactly {{c1::one}} trigger (bindings can be many)
column2: Two trigger entries = host indexing fails.

column1: Cosmos DB change feed captures inserts and updates only — never {{c1::deletes}}
column2: A PK change shows up as an insert of the new item.
